english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for issuing advice or a mild instruction.
This is the all-purpose choice for duty, advice, desirability, and likelihood.
Use 應該 when shall expresses obligation or what someone is expected to do.
Use 應該 for an obligation framed as what someone ought to do, rather than the stronger requirement expressed by 要.

examples.english: You should go to bed earlier.
examples.jyutping: nei5 jing1 goi1 zou2 di1 fan3

examples.english: It ought to rain tonight, so remember to bring an umbrella.
examples.traditional: 今晚應該會落雨，記得帶遮。
